script_text: Aquarius, this week forces a career choice, and your fixed-air instinct is tested. Friday shifts decisively as your 1st-house Moon opposes 7th-house Jupiter, exposing a relationship or contract issue. By Saturday, 10th-house Venus in Scorpio trines 6th-house Mars in Cancer, easing workplace attraction and clarifying salary negotiations. Sunday’s 2nd-house Moon sextiles Saturn, but the exact Sun-Saturn opposition exposes a career bottleneck. Saturday is your power day because Venus trines Mars, turning attraction or compensation talk into action. Sunday is your friction day because the Sun exactly opposes Saturn, risking a career ultimatum from management. Put every promise, price, and career plan in writing before noon. Follow for daily updates.
